body: Time flew by like a white steed, and in an instant, the faint glow of dawn quietly sprinkled upon the window, signaling the arrival of a new day.
※13⛬ slowly awoke, but he did not, as usual, go out for morning exercise with ※4⛬ immediately.
At this moment, his heart was filled with concern for the ※15⛬ egg he had nurtured with ※0⛬ last night.
So, he hurriedly walked towards where the ※15⛬ egg was placed, with a hint of nervousness and anticipation in his eyes.
When he carefully checked, he found that the ※15⛬ egg was perfectly fine, with vibrant life force seemingly leaping joyfully within the shell, and its aptitude was also slowly improving.

※13⛬ immediately felt a sense of relief, letting out a long sigh, and thought to himself, “Last night, I was a bit impulsive after all. Fortunately, everything is going smoothly now. This can be considered a good start.”

After ※13⛬ and ※4⛬ completed their morning exercise, ※13⛬ gently patted ※4⛬'s head and said warmly, “※4⛬, you can train by yourself at home today, and by the way, help me look after the ※15⛬ egg at home, alright?”
※4⛬ blinked its intelligent eyes, seemingly understanding ※13⛬'s meaning, and nodded obediently.
※13⛬ looked at ※4⛬'s appearance, his heart filled with satisfaction, and turned to prepare to head to the city's breeding house.
In fact, ※13⛬'s visit to the breeding house this time was not to purchase new ※15⛬.
He had a plan in mind; he already had three ※15⛬ that were about to hatch. Although ※7⛬ and ※9⛬ consumed relatively fewer resources during their growth,
with ※4⛬ and the unhatched ※11⛬, his resources were a bit tight.
He secretly pondered that as long as he could hold out until ※4⛬ successfully advanced to ※10⛬, and ※7⛬ and ※9⛬ successfully evolved into ※3⛬ and ※6⛬,
and possessed a certain level of combat ability, then he could embark on an adventure,
to complete the Hunter Guild's missions, thereby earning more resources to raise ※15⛬.
If he were to blindly add more ※15⛬ at this time, even if they had excellent aptitudes, he would struggle to provide enough resources for their training.
Of course, if he really encountered some rare ※15⛬, ※13⛬ would still take them, after all, rare ※15⛬ are not common.
※13⛬'s visit to the breeding house this time actually had a more important purpose.
He intended to use ※0⛬ to thoroughly investigate the physical conditions of the ※15⛬ in the breeding house, thereby collecting more valuable data.
Previously, he had only observed the situation within ※4⛬'s body, and some of his conjectures were inevitably one-sided.
He knew that to draw more accurate conclusions, he had to investigate more different types of ※15⛬.
His heart was full of curiosity, wanting to know if the energy channels within all ※15⛬ were the same in number, and if there were other differences.
However, ※15⛬ that he could freely touch and investigate could only be found in breeding houses.
After all, although not all ※15⛬ sold in breeding houses are gentle, they have all undergone systematic breeding and domestication beforehand.
Under normal circumstances, they would not easily attack humans, so they would allow customers interested in purchasing to touch and observe the ※15⛬.
This undoubtedly gave ※13⛬ an excellent opportunity for investigation; otherwise, he would truly struggle to find so many different types of ※15⛬ to investigate.
Of course, ※13⛬ was not a reckless person; he naturally would not touch every single ※15⛬ in the same breeding house.
He knew that if he acted that way, it would certainly arouse suspicion from others.
Thus, he very carefully selected only two or three different types of ※15⛬ for investigation in each breeding house,
and tried his best to act no different from other ordinary customers, so as not to attract attention from others.
In this way, ※13⛬ tirelessly traveled between various breeding houses, excluding the Rocket breeding house and the three official breeding houses of the Alliance.
He had almost visited every breeding house in ※2⛬.
During this process, all the ※15⛬ data he investigated were collected, tallied, and deeply analyzed by his AI system.
Although ※13⛬ had already tried his best, he clearly knew that there might still be some shortcomings in this data.
After all, the ※15⛬ in breeding houses generally have lower strength and are mostly in their initial forms. He could not determine if the situation within these ※15⛬ would change after evolution.
However, ※13⛬ still found a ※5⛬ in a breeding house and conducted a detailed investigation and calculation, carefully comparing the differences between it and his ※4⛬.
※13⛬ was not eager to check the data at this moment; he secretly pondered that he would slowly study it after returning home.
Subsequently, he turned and walked towards the store, preparing to purchase some necessary supplies.
In the store, he carefully selected some berries and medicinal herbs, which are crucial for ※15⛬ training and recovery.
Then, his gaze fell on a forced exercise device. After much deliberation, he decided to spend fifty thousand to buy it.
Fortunately, this exercise device had a specific category for ※4⛬, so there was no need for custom ordering, which saved a lot of time.
※13⛬ happily thought that after putting this on ※4⛬, its exercise effect would surely be twice as effective with half the effort.

A faint smile unconsciously appeared on his face, and he secretly praised himself, “I'm truly a good and responsible master. I don't forget to bring a gift for ※4⛬ even when I'm out running errands. I wonder if that little guy will be overjoyed when he sees it.”
At this moment, ※4⛬, who was secretly watching TV at home, suddenly felt a chilly breeze blow by, and its body shivered involuntarily.
For some reason, a strong ominous premonition surged in its heart, and the TV program it was originally watching with great interest instantly became dull.
It was full of worry, fearing that its master had returned, so it hurriedly ran to the big tree outside, stretching its neck to gaze into the distance.
After confirming that it did not see its master's figure, it finally breathed a slight sigh of relief.
However, ※4⛬ knew in its heart that ※12⛬ like this was not a long-term solution. It would be terrible if its master found out.
After much deliberation, it finally reluctantly turned off the TV and obediently ran into the yard to seriously begin training.

After ※13⛬ had arranged everything in the store, he roughly calculated that he had spent another one hundred thousand today, plus fifty thousand from yesterday. He originally had four hundred twenty thousand in hand, but now only two hundred seventy thousand remained.
He shook his head helplessly, sighing to himself, “This money really doesn't last! Raising ※15⛬ is truly too expensive.
I can still make ※1⛬s and ※14⛬ myself, and even then, I spend so much. What about those ordinary ※8⛬s?
No wonder commoner ※8⛬s, although there is no limit to the number of ※15⛬ they can catch,
generally only raise three or four ※15⛬, and it's even difficult to fill a team of six ※15⛬. The difficulty of raising ※15⛬ is evident from this.”
data.title: Chapter 22 Collecting Data
